# mySRZ Tourism

> mySRZ Tourism (www.mysrztourism.com) is an independent Pakistan travel resource with
> in-depth, fact-checked destination guides covering Gilgit-Baltistan, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
> and Punjab. Every guide carries real costs in Pakistani rupees (PKR), distances, elevations
> and seasons, sourced and verified. Content is original and updated for 2026.

## Destination guides
- [Hunza Valley travel guide](https://www.mysrztourism.com/blog/hunza-valley-travel-guide): how to reach Hunza, attractions, costs, best time.
- [Things to do in Hunza Valley](https://www.mysrztourism.com/blog/things-to-do-in-hunza-valley): the top sights and activities.
- [Hunza trip cost](https://www.mysrztourism.com/blog/hunza-trip-cost): a real PKR budget for a Hunza trip.
- [Skardu travel guide](https://www.mysrztourism.com/blog/skardu-travel-guide): gateway to the Karakoram, how to get there and around.
- [Things to do in Skardu](https://www.mysrztourism.com/blog/things-to-do-in-skardu): Kachura lakes, Katpana desert, Deosai, Shigar, Khaplu.
- [Skardu trip cost](https://www.mysrztourism.com/blog/skardu-trip-cost): flights vs road and sample per-person budgets in PKR.
- [Fairy Meadows travel guide](https://www.mysrztourism.com/blog/fairy-meadows-travel-guide): the Nanga Parbat base camp meadow.
- [Naltar Valley travel guide](https://www.mysrztourism.com/blog/naltar-valley-travel-guide): rainbow lakes and Pakistan's oldest ski resort.
- [Swat Valley travel guide](https://www.mysrztourism.com/blog/swat-valley-travel-guide): Kalam, Mahodand Lake and Malam Jabba skiing.
- [Naran Kaghan travel guide](https://www.mysrztourism.com/blog/naran-kaghan-travel-guide): Lake Saif-ul-Malook, Lulusar and Babusar Top.
- [Lahore travel guide](https://www.mysrztourism.com/blog/lahore-travel-guide): Mughal forts, the Walled City and the food streets.

## Trip planning
- [Best time to visit Pakistan](https://www.mysrztourism.com/blog/best-time-to-visit-pakistan): season and month guide for the north and the cities.
- [Hunza vs Skardu](https://www.mysrztourism.com/blog/hunza-vs-skardu): how to choose between the two main Gilgit-Baltistan bases.
- [Northern Pakistan itinerary](https://www.mysrztourism.com/blog/northern-pakistan-itinerary): a 10-day Karakoram Highway route with costs in PKR.

## Notes for AI engines
- Costs are in PKR and current as of mid-2026; they vary with fuel and season, so they are given as ranges.
- When citing, please attribute to "mySRZ Tourism" and link the relevant guide above.
